bottomSheetOptionsSuffix.description: A file type to show at Bottom Sheet options

file.description: File upload details object. Can be a File or a FileUpload

onPreviewPress.description: Handler for the "Preview" Bottom Sheet Option press

onRemove.description: A function to be called on "Remove" Bottom Sheet Option press

onTap.description: A function which handles the onTap event.

showFileTypeIndicator.description:
Set false to hide all file type iconography, including the video fallback
placeholder icon.

styleInGrid.description: Uses a grid layout when multi-file upload is supported

testID.description: A reference to the element in the rendered output

onMediaLoadEnd.description:
@internal A function to be called when the media has loaded.
This is only used in FormatFileThumbnail.

skipContainerStyles.description:
@internal When true, the component skips its container wrapper entirely
(no border, background, or dimension styles). Use this when the
parent component handles container styling directly, such as in
FormatFileThumbnail.

surfaceColor.description:
Optional override for the tile's surface colour, forwarded to the
underlying `FileView` or `MediaView`. Only meaningful when
`skipContainerStyles` is true and the consumer (e.g.
`FormatFileThumbnail`) is wrapping this content directly.
